name: Okinawa
about: Typhoon season runs Jun–Oct, peaking Aug–Sep; winter here is mild by Japanese standards, one of the few places in the country still pleasant Dec–Feb.
overview: Japan's subtropical Ryukyu Islands — a different culture, cuisine and history from the mainland, built around coral-reef diving and beaches.
costOverview: Okinawa runs cheaper than mainland Japan — a bowl of Okinawa soba costs less than equivalent ramen in Tokyo, and even the marquee Churaumi Aquarium stays reasonable.

specialSeasons.text: Typhoon season runs through this whole window, peaking Aug–Sep — check forecasts before booking a beach-focused trip.
Humpback whales migrate through Okinawan waters, with whale-watching tours running out of the Kerama Islands.
